data.name: WelcomeBody
data.value:
This wizard installs the WordOllama.JS Desktop Bridge and registers the Word add-in for your Windows account.
Close Microsoft Word before continuing when possible. Save any open WPS documents; Setup can offer to close WPS before files are updated.
No administrator account is required.
